aegworldwide-aegworldwide:greenhouse:847.description: Company Information For more than 20 years, AEG has played a pivotal role in transforming sports and live entertainment. Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer. Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations. If you want to be challenged to up your game and make a difference, then join us in giving the world reason to cheer! Job Summary The VIP Coordinator will manage the VIP list and proactively monitor and engage with VIP clients to provide the highest quality of customer service. This position will maintain the professionalism, cleanliness, and standards of all VIP areas and ensure efficiency of execution and delivery of amenities and services. Essential Functions Proactively monitor and engage with VIP clients and provide the highest quality of customer service in a friendly and timely manner. Maintain professionalism, cleanliness, and standards of all VIP areas. May assist with general office duties. coatesgroup-coatesgroup:lever:48848983-c.description: Be Part of Our Next Chapter For over almost 60 years, our solutions have enabled impactful connections between some of the world’s leading brands and their customers. And while we’ve already done a lot of work we’re proud of, we’re just getting started! We’re a global technology company focused on creating dynamic, smart, personalized and engaging customer experiences powered by our range of digital hardware, our proprietary content management system and our industry leading signage solutions. (For example: If you’ve ordered in-store or in the drive-thru at McDonald’s somewhere in the world in the last few years, chances are you’ve interacted with our digital solutions.) We work in over 50 global markets and have 9 offices around the world, with a global headquarters proudly located in our founding home of Sydney, Australia. Coates Group has the values of a family-owned business and the innovative spirit of a start-up, both which fuel our purpose – Creating Connections. Empowering Partnerships. Always Evolving. Through hard work, dedication and creativity, we’ve become industry leaders who have won awards and set records while remaining focused on continual growth and evolution. We are a 2x Australia Good Design Award winner and successfully completed the largest hardware deployment in Quick Service Restaurant history. We are curious, charismatic, authentic and we value and leverage the diversity of our crew. We are imaginers, kindness enthusiasts, experts, creators, thinkers, challengers, collaborators and over-achievers. And together, as a Crew, we are revolutionizing the way the world’s leading brands leverage technology to drive the best customer experiences. Reporting to the Global Marketing Director, this role will be responsible for supporting marketing projects from a coordination perspective, including: management of projects which are being briefed from internal business functions (P&C, Account Management, etc.), supporting internal BMC projects and initiatives, event coordination to support events and conventions, assisting with BMC workflow coordination and supporting delivery of internal comms as needed.
responsibilities: Supports key marketing projects from a coordination perspective.
Assists with admin tasks from a business engagement perspective - eg small edits to existing materials.
Coordinate marketing tasks and projects from a workflow perspective.
Manages merchandise, ordering, stock and benchmarking of prices/products to ensure we're accessing the most competitive and quality items. Build merch portal for self-service Crew orders.
Collaborates with Marketing Manager NAM on promotion and coordination of charity-based activities, specifically RHMC.
Supports coordination of Crewsletter and delivery of internal P&C culture initiatives  (E&E/Thrive).
Supports the creation and delivery of BAU content scheduling for Coates social channels.
Collaborates with Global Marketing Director to make required minor updates to the Coates website.
Actively helps with implementations of brand-related projects such as embedding of our values.
Conduct and monitor competitor landscape, creating analysis and summary of intelligence which can be used to inform positioning of the Coates brand.
Maintain and manage an up-to-date product portal to ensure accuracy of information to support product marketing
Support and provide recommendations on the taxonomy of content documentation and file control to enable Brand, Marketing & Comms team to operate in an effective way
Conduct desk research to support and inform positioning on industry trends and in turn help to raise the profile of key stakeholders at Coates, as well as the Coates brand.
Support showroom management process.
qualifications: Exposure in managing workflows in Asana. Experience in Figma is preferable.
Ability to create user generated content to share on social platforms is preferable.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:8304b257-63d8-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Software Engineer, Backend - Data Layer based in Italy. As a Backend Software Engineer on the Data Layer team, you’ll help build and evolve the storage and query infrastructure behind a large-scale process orchestration platform. You’ll work across relational databases and Elasticsearch/OpenSearch to keep process data reliable, performant, and available. Your work will directly support capabilities ranging from process monitoring to emerging AI-driven automation experiences. You’ll tackle complex challenges around data storage, retention, streaming, secondary storage, and scalability. The role offers strong ownership, with opportunities to shape technical solutions from requirements through production delivery. You’ll collaborate closely with Product, QA, SRE, Support, and fellow engineers in a remote-first environment. It’s an opportunity to make a meaningful impact on a sophisticated backend platform while growing your expertise in data-intensive systems. Design, build, and maintain backend services responsible for storing and serving process data across relational databases and Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, with a strong focus on correctness, performance, reliability, and scalability. Own engineering initiatives end to end, translating product requirements into technical designs, breaking complex work into actionable tasks, and driving delivery to a high standard. Help evolve how process data is processed, retained, exposed, and streamed so customers can access and use their data effectively. Improve the performance and scalability of secondary storage systems as platform usage grows, while developing tooling that supports observability, troubleshooting, and safe production operations. Investigate and resolve complex data-layer production issues, including slow queries, indexing problems, and execution-plan challenges, as part of L3 support and on-call rotations. Partner with Product Management, Support, SRE, QA, and other engineering teams to ensure technical solutions meet customer needs and production requirements. Contribute to continuous improvement by bringing lessons from production incidents and customer feedback back into engineering practices and product development. Requirements: At least 4 years of professional experience as a Backend Software Engineer, with a strong focus on backend systems and production data stores. Hands-on experience with at least one major database or search technology such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, MSSQL, Elasticsearch, or OpenSearch. Practical understanding of query performance, indexing strategies, data modeling, execution plans, and the trade-offs involved in designing data-intensive systems. Demonstrated experience contributing to complex engineering initiatives, including requirements analysis, technical design, task decomposition, implementation, and reliable delivery. Ability to troubleshoot data-related production issues and investigate slow queries, index usage, and other performance bottlenecks. Strong communication and collaboration skills, particularly in a remote-first environment, with the ability to work effectively with Product and engineering stakeholders and provide and receive constructive code-review feedback. Willingness to use and understand the product as part of developing customer-focused solutions. Experience with workflow automation, process orchestration, or developer platforms is a plus. Experience working across both relational databases and Elasticsearch/OpenSearch is advantageous. Familiarity with CI pipelines and database migration or schema-evolution tools such as Liquibase or Flyway is beneficial. Benefits: Competitive, transparent, location-based compensation, with the applicable range determined by skills, experience, and location. jobgether-jobgether:lever:f1f42e29-bbfb-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Estonian Voice Actor - Freelance AI Trainer Project based in India. This role offers an opportunity for an experienced Estonian voice professional to contribute directly to the development of next-generation AI voice technologies. You will use your vocal expertise to create and evaluate high-quality training data for advanced language and speech models. The work combines professional voice performance with linguistic evaluation, annotation, and AI-assisted testing. You’ll assess pronunciation, tone, pacing, emotional expression, and naturalness across a variety of speech samples. Your feedback will help improve how AI systems understand and reproduce authentic Estonian speech. The role is well suited to detail-oriented voice professionals who are curious about emerging technology and passionate about language. You’ll contribute to AI experiences designed to become more natural, expressive, accessible, and useful for people worldwide. Record scripted speech material in Estonian for use in AI training and evaluation datasets. Evaluate AI-generated voice outputs for pronunciation, linguistic accuracy, naturalness, tone, pacing, and overall quality. Provide nuanced feedback on emotional expression, vocal delivery, regional variation, and other characteristics of authentic Estonian speech. Identify and annotate errors or inconsistencies in AI-generated speech and clearly document your observations. Work with project teams to refine prompts, evaluation methodologies, and voice-design guidelines. Apply professional voice-acting judgment to help distinguish natural, expressive speech from outputs that require improvement. Contribute consistently high-quality recordings and structured evaluations while following project guidelines and technical requirements. Requirements Demonstrated professional experience in voice acting, dubbing, narration, or related performance work in Estonian. Strong command of Estonian pronunciation, intonation, pacing, and natural spoken expression. Ability to deliver clear, authentic, and consistent vocal performances across scripted material. Excellent attention to detail when evaluating pronunciation, tone, emotional expression, and linguistic accuracy. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to provide clear and actionable feedback. Experience in voice training, coaching, linguistic annotation, language evaluation, or similar work is a plus. Interest in AI, speech technologies, language models, or technology evaluation is advantageous. Ability to work independently and reliably in a remote freelance environment. Access to a high-quality recording setup, including a reliable microphone and quiet recording environment. Secure computer and stable internet connection suitable for completing recording and evaluation tasks. Benefits Freelance contract opportunity with flexible remote work. Pay range of $6 to $65 per hour , depending on experience, expertise, and geographic location. Opportunity to contribute professional Estonian language and voice expertise to advanced AI development. Exposure to cutting-edge AI voice and speech technologies. Opportunity to influence the quality, naturalness, and authenticity of future AI voice experiences. Work that can contribute to applications across education, entertainment, accessibility, and other global use cases. As a contractor, company-sponsored benefits such as health insurance and paid time off are not provided. Contractors are responsible for providing their own secure computer, high-quality microphone, recording environment, and stable internet connection. southparkcommons-longshot:rippling:e380a.description: Who are we? Longshot Space Technologies is at the cutting edge of low-cost space access and hypersonics. We are developing a novel space launch system that accelerates mass over a long distance. Using our technology, we plan to provide affordable launch services for satellites, cargo, and future space infrastructure. Our mission is to enable a future where humans can reach for the stars. Position Overview We're hiring a Lead Systems Engineer to be the technical face of Longshot to the Department of War (DoW) and the technical spine of our defense capture efforts. You'll shape technical solutions during early customer pursuits (capture), write the white papers and design review packages that carry them, and stand in front of program offices to defend them, owning the translation between what our accelerator can do and what the DoW is trying to buy. You'll report to the VP of Government Programs, working as a peer to Longshot's engineering and manufacturing leads with direct visibility into the technical baseline for every defense pursuit. This is a senior individual contributor role today, with a clear path to building a defense systems engineering team as our program portfolio grows. The role is split deliberately: roughly 75% of your time is with Government Programs on capture and execution, and 25% stays embedded with the core engineering team, because you can't credibly represent a technology you've stopped touching. It's a rare seat that combines deep technical ownership with direct customer-facing influence, rather than one narrow slice of either.
